name: Mistral Small 4

license.name: Apache 2.0
license.commercial_use: Apache 2.0 supports commercial and non-commercial use.
license.eu_note: No explicit EU territorial restriction identified in the reviewed model materials.

hardware_note: Official NVFP4 checkpoint can materially reduce memory versus BF16.
owm_view: Mistral Small 4 is an unusually dense package of deployment features: multimodal input, reasoning and non-reasoning modes, function calling, a 256K context window, MoE efficiency and Apache 2.0 licensing. OWM sees the official NVFP4 checkpoint as especially important because it turns quantization from a community afterthought into a publisher-supported deployment path.
